purpose: Evaluate a finite batch of materially distinct alpha hypotheses abstracted from the already-frozen Freqtrade intake without importing external performance claims.

market_data.execution: signal on completed hourly candle t; enter/exit at next available hourly candle open t+1; no same-candle execution

decision_rule.validation_pass: discovery_pass AND effect_validation > 0 AND effect_validation >= 0.50 * effect_discovery AND mean_net_primary_validation > 0 AND mean_net_stress_validation >= 0
decision_rule.holdout_pass: validation_pass AND effect_holdout > 0 AND effect_holdout >= 0.50 * effect_discovery AND mean_net_primary_holdout > 0 AND mean_net_stress_holdout >= 0

families.entry_common: close_t < SMA20_t - width * population_sd20_t; optional RSI gate evaluated on t; enter next open
families.exit_common: first completed t with close_t >= SMA20_t OR max_hold_48_hours; exit next open

families.entry_common: bullish event fully determined at close t; enter next open
families.exit_common: fixed 24 completed hourly bars after entry; exit next open; no pattern-selected horizon

variants.pattern: previous bearish; current bullish; current real body engulfs previous real body
bullish or bearish body allowed; lower shadow >=2x body; upper shadow <= body; body >0
three-bar: bearish large first body; second body <=0.5 first body; third bullish close above midpoint of first body
previous bearish; current bullish opens <= previous close and closes > previous body midpoint but < previous open

families.entry_common: at close t fast>mid>slow and prior completed bar was not strictly ordered; enter next open
families.exit_common: at close t fast<=mid OR mid<=slow; exit next open

candidate_construction: 12 frozen variants x 2 frozen assets; all exist before any Grammar 008 market-data outcome read
